Vehicles built only from facility materials (Steel Construction Materials, Assembly Materials, Rare Alloys) have no clean conversion: band them by judgement against Garage vehicles of the same class, and record every Heavy Tank Assembly vehicle (battle and super tanks, 18 to 48 hours to build) as very high. Thresholds at 0.5, 0.9, 1.4 and 2 times the anchor.
